caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass candlestick holder with a faint blue-green tint. The object stands upright and is composed of several distinct sections: a wide, flat circular base at the bottom providing stability, a slender and graceful stem that bulges at two points in the middle, and a decorative section beneath the candle socket that features a twisted, spiral design. The candle socket at the top is flared and open to accommodate a candle. The entire candlestick holder is rendered with careful shading and highlights, creating a realistic representation of the reflective and refractive qualities of glass. The background is plain and light-colored, without any additional objects or decoration.
title: Candlestick
